description: This file defines a PHP class `SeoRegex` within the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically in the admin controller module for managing SEO regular expression rules. It includes methods for displaying, listing, creating, editing, and deleting SEO regex entries, as well as handling permissions and outputs.

classes.name: SeoRegex
classes.description: Controller class for managing SEO regex rules in the admin panel, handles CRUD operations and displays the interface for SEO regex rules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial entry point, loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and loads the main view with SEO regex list.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of SEO regex entries by calling getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves the paginated list of SEO regex entries from the database, prepares pagination data, and returns the rendered list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an SEO regex entry, pre-filling data if editing an existing entry.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles save operation for SEO regex entries, supports add and edit, with permission check.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected SEO regex entries, with permission check.
